# 2 Baruch Chapter 60 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "The black waters that followed the second bright waters represent all the sins the generation of your fathers committed before the Lord — sins even worse than what the first generation had done."

**2** "They forsook the Most High, corrupted his statutes, abandoned his ways, went after their own handiwork, and served idols. All these evils were committed during their generation."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
